record.name: Driver
record.description: Drivers are masters of ground vehicles and speed, using their piloting skills to navigate dangerous terrain and transport allies through the most challenging environments.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Piloting virtuosos who command speed and precision on any terrain.

progression_tree.description: You gain advantage on any Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw against a vehicle's hazard. While piloting a ground vehicle, you have darkvision out to 60 feet.

You can add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make that involves operating a ground vehicle. When you are the driver of a ground vehicle, you can use your reaction to take the vehicle's speed as an opportunity attack.
You gain a +1 bonus to your initiative. When you are driving through difficult terrain, you can use your reaction to move the vehicle up to 10 feet without hindering it.
You learn to navigate even the most treacherous terrain. When you are piloting a ground vehicle, you can use your reaction to take a short or long rest.
You have expertise in two skills of your choice that involve operating a ground vehicle. When you are the driver of a ground vehicle, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a crouched stance with knees bent and weight evenly distributed between both feet, ready to pounce into action.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounding the Driver's lightsaber is an aura of kinetic energy, pulsating with a bright blue light that seems to be fueled by their raw power and speed.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate a highly detailed image of a skilled Driver navigating a treacherous asteroid field at high speeds in a sleek starfighter.
contextual_modifiers: Show the pilot wearing a distinctive black and silver flight suit
Highlight the starfighter's advanced shields and armor plating
